adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking, evt.destinationCalendar is set to `null` when both `eventType.destinationCalendar` and `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` are falsy (lines shown: `... : null,`). Later, for COLLECTIVE team events, member calendars are accumulated into `teamDestinationCalendars`, but the code uses `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which no-ops when `evt.destinationCalendar` is null—silently dropping the collected member destination calendars. This is inconsistent with other handlers in the diff that fall back to `[]` and would allow pushing/iteration logic to work.
